notes.title: Added New Systems to DEEMO -Reborn- STEAM Version
notes.content:
Added New Systems to DEEMO -Reborn- STEAM Version
STEAM Page: http://short.rayark.com/DRsteam

https://youtu.be/VNYtwKHp6Gg

During a song, pressing Settings on the bottom right corner will allow you to choose "Random Chart" and "Autoplay".

The scores accumulated during Autoplay will still make the tree grow, allowing players to explore new areas!

The Random Chart mode is always different, with every note's placement completely random, giving players a new way to test their reflexes!

※ Keymapping for rhythm sections will be added in the next update.
※ To report any gameplay issues please send an email to service@rayark.com.

notes.content:
